name: durabull
description: BullMQ queue management and Redis monitoring with Durabull. Explore background jobs, diagnose failures and backlogs, inspect workers and repeatable schedules, review alerts, and retry, promote, pause or resume on request.

interface.longDescription: Inspect your BullMQ queues and Redis health without leaving the conversation. Find jobs across queues, investigate failures with redacted payloads, logs and stacktraces, measure throughput, inspect workers and recurring schedules, and review incidents and notification delivery. Explore interactive queue, job, schedule, alert and health views in MCP Apps hosts. Retry failed jobs, promote delayed jobs, pause or resume queues, and manage alert acknowledgements and snoozes when requested. Connect Durabull Cloud or a self-hosted installation with scoped OAuth access.
defaultPrompt: Check my BullMQ queues for backlogs, failures and missing workers.
Find a job by ID and explain why it failed.
Show my recurring jobs and their next scheduled runs.
